{{Quote|... Great weapons were unleashed, forever scarring the surface and traumatizing the Keshiri natives. With titans battling, Kesh bled...|Kaliska recounting the Great Calamity|<ref name="Spiral 2" />}}
The '''Great Calamity''' was an event remembered in the legends of the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The Calamity was caused by a massive conflict between the [[Skyborn|Protectors]] and the [[Destructors]], resulting in the reshaping of the very surface of the world. The legends were based on Keshiri memories of an ancient conflict between [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who had become stranded on Kesh following the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]].

They fought a fierce struggle which devastated large areas of Kesh's surface and terrorized the Keshiri natives. Eventually, the two warring factions decided to make peace and the Dark Jedi agreed to seal their "[[Remulus Dreypa|great weapon]]." These Force-users then migrated to the polar continent of [[Eshkrene]] in the planet's South Pole where they established a new neutral Force order which became known as "[[the Doomed]]."

==History==
===Origins===
{{Quote|I helped found the Sith philosophy years ago. And even then, my lessers were content to rule mongrels in exile. But not me! I left then&mdash;as I intend to do again now. I reject Kesh&mdash;just as I rejected the Stygian Caldera! The stars are my domain. And I will have them again.|Sith Lord Remulus Dreypa|<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith—Spiral 3">[[Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral 3|''Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral'' 3]]</ref>}}
[[File:Dark_Jedi_Starship.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Dark Jedi were pursued by the Jedi outside the Stygian Caldera]]
The Great Calamity's roots can be traced back to the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], which marked a major schism between the orthodox [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-wielding [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].<ref name="Spiral 2" /> These Dark Jedi pioneered the science of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and created various [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] including the serpentine [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathans]], serpentine beasts which devoured the life energies of other beings. After decades of fighting, the Dark Jedi were defeated at the [[Battle of Corbos]] around [[6900 BBY]] and the Jedi and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] reasserted control over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

Some Dark Jedi including [[Karness Muur]], [[Remulus Dreypa]], and [[XoXaan]] escaped the conflict and fled into the [[Stygian Caldera]]. These Dark Jedi discovered the planets [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] along with the native red-skinned [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]]. The Dark Jedi used their Force powers to take control of the Sith and created the first [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. Through this cross-cultural contact, the term Sith became synonymous with the dark side-wielding [[Sith Order]], which would pose a major threat to the Jedi and the Republic in the preceeding millennia.<ref name="Spiral 2" />

After a period of consolidation, Dreypa and several other exiles decided that it was time to leave the Stygian Caldera and take their revenge on the Jedi and the weakened Republic. Dreypa and his followers managed to acquired a [[Dark Jedi Starship|large starship]] and several Leviathan larvae from the Sith Lord [[Sorzus Syn]]'s laboratory on Korriban. Dreypa's ship managed to navigate its way out of the tricky Stygian Caldera. However, they encountered a [[Jedi faction (Doomed)|group]] of Jedi veterans from Corbos who were still scouring the galaxy to hunt for their Dark Jedi opponents. After a pursuit across the galaxy, the Jedi and Sith ships crash landed on Kesh.<ref name="Spiral 2" />

===Jedi versus Sith===
{{Quote|With no time to report back, the true Jedi chased their fallen brothers across the galaxy. Finally, the pursuit ended here on Kesh. And so Kesh's troubles began. The world's strange magnetic field prevented the Jedi from calling for aid and the Dark Jedi needed none...|Kaliska|<ref name="Spiral 2" />}}
[[File:TheDoomedMigrateToEshkrene-Spiral2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|the Doomed migrating to Eshkrene]]
After landing on Kesh, the Jedi and [[Dark Jedi faction (Doomed)|Dark Jedi]] fought a fierce battle which would engulf the planet and threaten the indigenous [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]], a purple-skinned humanoid species. Kesh's unusual magnetic field prevented both sides from calling for reinforcements of leaving the planet. During the Great Calamity, Dreypa's Dark Jedi followers unleashed several great weapons including Leviathans which devastated much of Kesh's surface. Many Keshiri were killed and many settlements were destroyed during this fighting. Eventually, even Dreypa's Dark Jedi became disillusioned with the destruction they had wrought on Kesh.<ref name="Spiral 2" />

With their leader Remulus Dreypa unable to see reason and end his quest for vengeance, his Dark Jedi followers sealed him within an [[Oubliette (stasis casket)|oubliette]] where he would remain in stasis for nearly four millennia. The two rival Force orders then made peace and began a process of reconciliation. Since Kesh was still isolated from the rest of the galaxy, the Jedi and Dark Jedi agreed to withdraw from the Keshiri whom they had threatened.<ref name="Spiral 2" /> One [[Last Hope (Jedi starship)|Jedi starship]] also survived the conflict. Since the survivors had agreed that no one who was Force-sensitive could ever leave the planet, they decided to hide the vessel in the Keshiri burial cairns beneath the city of [[Tahv]]. However, they still preserved this knowledge in the event that they had to leave Kesh.<ref name="Spiral 4">[[Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral 4|''Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral'' 4]]</ref>

These Force users eventually traveled to the frozen continent of [[Eshkrene]], which was situated in Kesh's South Pole. On Eshkrene, these former Jedi and Dark Jedi established a new community known as [[the Doomed]] who regarded [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] as a curse rather than an extraordinary advantage. They sought to find true neutrality in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in order to balance both the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and dark sides. For four millennia, the Doomed and their descendants remained on Eshkrene. They would later use [[ice image]]s to monitor the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], another group of stranded Force-users who arrived during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="Spiral 2" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Wait. You mean the Keshiri legends of the Protectors and Destructors and the Great Calamaity -- The ones my people co-opted -- Those were real?|Takara Hilt's response to learning about the true history of the Calamity|<ref name="Spiral 2" />}}
[[File:The_Doomed.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Doomed were the descendants of the Jedi and the Dark Jedi]]
The Great Calamity was not the only incident when Sith [[Exiles]] tried to threaten the Jedi and the Republic. Another [[First battle between Jedi and Sith|conflict]] was fought between the Jedi and Sith prior to the Great Hyperspace War. However, in this case the Jedi won and and reported this news to the Jedi Council.<ref name="TEGTTF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> The ancient Keshiri would remember the Great Calamity as a clash between two powerful groups of god-like entities known as the Protectors and [[Destructors]].<ref name="Spiral 2" /> This became connected to an earlier Keshiri legend about the [[Skyborn]], a powerful sandy-[[Blood/Legends|blooded]] race of god-like beings, who had fought against the malevolent [[Otherside]]&mdash;beings of fire, rebellion, sickness, and death&mdash;during the [[Great Battle]].<ref name="Skyborn">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]''</ref>

In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], another group of Sith exiles from the Sith Empire became stranded on Kesh after their ship ''[[Omen]]'' was damaged during the Great Hyperspace War. Most of these Sith exiles were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] miners and ship crew who had been tasked with delivering a shipment of [[Lignan crystal]]s to the Sith's [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]. By that period, the descendants of the Dark Jedi exiles had cohabited with the indigenous Red Sith and carved up a sizeable regional empire. However, contact with the Republic in 5000 BBY led to the Great Hyperspace War which culminated in the collapse of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref>

Under the leadership of [[Yaru Korsin]], the Human Sith assumed lordship over the Keshiri on [[Keshtah Minor]] by claiming that they were the legendary Protectors who had come down from the stars to visit their planet. These Sith became known as the Lost Tribe of Sith and would rule Kesh for several millennia. Despite their self-exile to Eshkrene, the Doomed still monitored developments in the other parts of Kesh.<ref name="Spiral 2" /> By [[2975 BBY]], the Lost Tribe under the leadership of [[Grand Lord]] [[Varner Hilts]] had annexed [[Alanciar]] and embarked on a maritime exploration program. This set in motion a chain of events in [[2974 BBY]] which brought the Lost Tribe into contact with the Doomed.<ref name="Spiral 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Great Calamity was first developed as a plot element by [[John Jackson Miller]]. It first appeared in [[Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral 2|''Lost Tribe of the Sith—Spiral 2'']], the second issue of the [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral|''Spiral'']] comic arc, which debuted on [[September 12]], [[2012]]. The Great Calamity is occasionally mentioned through the arc which ended on [[December 12]], [[2012]].
